name: Okuma (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Okuma town emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars, with a stylised peak at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Okuma, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 November 1969.

features.role: Okuma town emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars, with a stylised peak at the top
